title: Who May Hold Each Northloop Payments Payout Plan
content:
Each Northloop Payments payout plan has entry requirements on the seller profile's age, the seller's performance standing level and the trailing 12-month sale credits, a fallback plan used at plan review, and a fixed review cycle and effective point for plan changes.

## Requirements by plan

| Payout plan | Minimum account age (days) | Eligible standing levels | Minimum trailing 12-month sale credits (USD) | Standing fallback plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payments Starter | 0 | Below Standard Level, Developing Seller Level, Standard Level, Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0.00 | not applicable |
| Payments Biweekly | 90 | Standard Level, Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0.00 | Payments Starter |
| Payments Weekly | 90 | Standard Level, Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0.00 | Payments Biweekly |
| Payments Daily | 180 | Above Standard Level, Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 0.00 | Payments Weekly |
| Payments Daily Plus | 365 | Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 25000.00 | Payments Daily |
| Payments Enterprise | 365 | Top Rated Level, Preferred Partner Level | 1000000.00 | Payments Daily |

On every plan, plan qualification is reviewed monthly, after the standing evaluation, and a plan change takes effect from the next payout cycle.

## Definitions

- **Minimum account age** — the minimum age of the seller profile, counted from the date the account was opened, to hold the plan.
- **Eligible standing levels** — the Seller Performance Standing levels allowed to hold the plan, by their official level names.
- **Minimum trailing 12-month sale credits** — the minimum sale credits over the trailing 12 months to hold the plan, USD.
- **Standing fallback plan** — the plan the account is moved to at a plan review when it no longer qualifies, by its official plan name; not applicable for plans open to every level.
- **Plan review cycle** — when payout plan qualification is reviewed: monthly, after the standing evaluation.
- **Plan change effective** — when a payout plan change takes effect: from the next payout cycle.

The entry gate of Payments Starter turns on account age alone; Payments Biweekly, Payments Weekly and Payments Daily add the eligible standing levels; Payments Daily Plus and Payments Enterprise add the minimum trailing sale credits as well.

*Hypothetical reading.* A seller profile opened 200 days ago at Above Standard Level meets the age and level requirements of Payments Daily (180 days; Above Standard Level listed) but not the 365-day age of Payments Daily Plus.
